SELECT
    day_type,
    round(100.0 * sales_amount / sum(sales_amount) OVER (), 2) AS sales_percentage
FROM
(
    SELECT
        if(d.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday'), 'Weekend', 'Weekday') AS day_type,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON fs.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY day_type
)
ORDER BY day_type;
